text:
The **Hansen/UMD Global Forest Change dataset (GFC-2025-v1.13)** indicates tree cover was present during 2020: it recorded 67.7 ha of tree-cover loss that year.

However, the **JRC Global Forest Cover 2020 dataset (V4)** mapped 0 ha of forest on the property in its 2020 reference map. The Hansen loss record does not establish how much forest remained at the end of 2020.
